item.title: Grounded Raises $5M to Scale Modular Vehicle Platforms
item.description: Detroit startup Grounded lands a $5 million seed round, expanding its 50k‑sq‑ft Detroit plant to deliver modular, vehicle‑agnostic workspaces for EV and gas fleets.
